Daily Devotional

July 13

12 Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling. (Philippians 2:12 KJV)

Paul is admonishing his followers to obey the commandments of the Lord in his absence, just like they always did in his presence. What we do when we are not in the presence of other Christians, especially our Pastor, shows if we are truly walking in the Spirit, as Christians should. Our life is the only bible some people will ever read, so it should reflect our Christian values at all times (1 Peter 1:15). When you walk after the Spirit instead of the flesh, you will not have your conscience condemn you (Romans 8:1).

The Greek word “KATERGAZOMAI” that was translated “work out” means to “carry to its ultimate conclusion”, so it is telling the Philippians to carry their salvation to its conclusion, which is to reach Christ likeness, as that is what being a Christian means (little Christ). That is what all Christians are supposed to do, and we must work out our salvation to its conclusion so that the world will see the light of Jesus in us all (Matthew 5:16). We need to live a holy life, as Jesus is holy (1 John 1:16), and we can not properly represent Him if we don’t live like Him. Let your light shine into this dark world – praise God.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
